# Nina Munteanu Writing Coach

> > Award-winning eco-fiction author, ecologist, and writing coach specializing in climate fiction, science fiction, and The Fiction Writer craft methodology.

Nina Munteanu is an internationally published author of The Icaria Trilogy and Gaia's Revolution, a writing coach with SF Canada, and author of The Fiction Writer: Get Published, Write Now! textbook. Her work explores deep ecology, climate change, and transhumanism through speculative fiction.

## About Nina Munteanu

- [Publications](https://ninamunteanu.me/about/publications): Bibliography of novels, stories & articles published internationally
- [Why I Write](https://ninamunteanu.me/about/why-i-write): Writing philosophy & creative motivation inspired by Asimov & Cameron

## The Fiction Writer: Writing Craft A-Z

- [The A to Z of Writing Fiction: G, H, I](https://ninamunteanu.me/2024/03/17/the-a-to-z-of-writing-fiction-g-h-i): Genre definition & setting craft from The Fiction Writer textbook
- [The A to Z of Writing Fiction: J, K, L](https://ninamunteanu.me/2024/03/24/the-a-to-z-of-writing-fiction-j-k-l): Hero's Journey & Campbell's monomyth in fiction writing craft
- [The A to Z of Writing Fiction: M, N, O](https://ninamunteanu.me/2024/03/31/the-a-to-z-of-writing-fiction-m-n-o): Mastering metaphor & literary devices from The Fiction Writer guide
- [The A to Z of Writing Fiction: P](https://ninamunteanu.me/2024/04/07/the-a-to-z-of-writing-fiction-p): Plotting with purpose using Dibell's scenes & sequels framework
- [Things You Should Know About Editing an Anthology](https://ninamunteanu.me/2025/10/12/things-you-should-know-about-editing-an-anthology): Anthology editing advice from Jane Friedman article featuring Timpf

## Eco-Fiction & Climate Fiction

- [What Genre Is My Story? Is it Eco-Fiction or Something Else?](https://ninamunteanu.me/2025/08/24/what-genre-is-my-story-is-it-eco-fiction-or-something-else): Exploring eco-fiction genre evolution & eco-SciFi with Robinson & Powers
- [Movie Review: Soylent Green Is…](https://ninamunteanu.me/2025/02/02/movie-review-soylent-green-is): Review of Fleischer's 1973 dystopian eco-thriller Soylent Green
- [Author Interview: Terry Birdgenaw Talks About Insects, Climate Change and his Latest Book](https://ninamunteanu.me/2025/12/21/author-interview-terry-birdgenaw-talks-about-insects-climate-change-and-his-latest-book): Interview with Birdgenaw on The Antunite Chronicles CliFi series

## Writing Process & Author Insights

- [Nina Munteanu Talks about Writing—Passion, Process, and Publication—with Mandy Eve-Barnett](https://ninamunteanu.me/2021/09/04/nina-munteanu-talks-about-writing-passion-process-and-publication-with-mandy-eve-barnett): Interview on 'A Diary in the Age of Water' & writing journey with Barnett
- [How Walking in Nature Helps Me Write](https://ninamunteanu.me/2019/04/12/how-walking-in-nature-helps-me-write): Nature walking as creative process & cure for writer's block at Rouge River
